desc:
Welcome to Furinfection, a furry infection game where humans fight the furrys with many differents weapons for sale at the shop (Inside Safe zone)

NEW CODE AT 48,000 LIKES👍

Working codes are listed on the group !

🙍‍♂️ - The goal as a human is to survive and fight the infecteds using plenty of tools that you can buy with Money (Earn money by collecting Money stacks on the ground).
🧟‍♂️ - The goal as an infected is to spread the infection and take over the facility ! (Click to grab and infect player)
- 🔪 In-game items bought at the Shop are one-life only (Lost when you die)
- 💰 Gamepass are permanent (Example : If you own the Pistol gamepass you will spawn with it for free)
- 👥 Group members get +10 extra health !
- ⭐ Premium users receive 50$ every 5 minutes.

Abusing a bug, Glitching or Exploiting will result in a permanent ban from the game.
